prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Production CUTOUT PART ATLAS for the exact supplied spring-guardian pose. This is hidden-surface completion for separate 2D skeletal parts, NOT a new character or animation sheet. Match the reference's visible part shapes, curvature, cream/coral/olive palette, shading and dark outline precisely. Separate and complete all hidden roots/undersides. Each cutout must be complete and clean, no chopped flat cuts, holes, neighboring anatomy or disconnected scraps. Transparent background. ONE square 4x4 atlas with 16 equal cells, one whole cutout centered per cell with 15% padding, no grid, no text or labels. Cell order left-to-right/top-to-bottom: Row1 (1) bare cream feathered BODY, no head/wing/tail/legs/ruff; (2) HEAD with same beak, eye and green scalp cap, no crest or neck collar; (3) complete folded green WING only; (4) farther GOLD FOOT only. Row2 (5) nearer GOLD FOOT; (6) entire connected coral/cream NECK COLLAR only with smoothly completed roots; (7) first/front CREST feather only; (8) second CREST feather only. Row3 (9) third/back CREST feather only; (10) fourth/short rear CREST feather only; (11) first outer TAIL feather, tallest upright right plume; (12) second outer TAIL feather, tall upright left plume. Row4 (13) third outer TAIL feather, long diagonal upper-right plume; (14) fourth outer TAIL feather, wide curved middle-right C plume; (15) fifth outer TAIL feather, short lower curled C plume; (16) inner TAIL FAN cluster of small overlapping coral/cream leaves with connected root. For cells 7..15 give a single complete feather, not two merged feathers, and keep its reference-pose curvature. No full birds, alternate views, duplicate heads, backgrounds, cast shadows, extra pieces or missing cells. This reference is the neutral standing pose: head eye OPEN, each foot OPEN with three toes. Crest feathers sweep upward/back as in this reference, not hanging. Tail fan erect as in reference.
